== Description ==
'''Raw Dinner''' is an [[Emotes|emote]] that could have been obtained through the [[Frost Invasion Event#Frost Invasion Season Pass|Frost Invasion Season]]. It was made by [https://www.roblox.com/users/16983447/profile BelowNatural]. The emote is looped and no music can be heard while performing the emote, though eating sound effects can be heard. You can move while performing this emote.

This emote was obtainable at Rank 6 of the to the Event Season Pass, which would cost {{Shards|500 Shards}} or {{Robux|225}} at that rank. The total cost was {{Shards|1,975 Shards}} or {{Robux|800}}.

== Trivia ==
*This [[Emotes|emote]], along with the [[Lazy Couch]], [[Firework]], [[Frozen (Emote)|Frozen]], [[Recliner]] and [[Axe Throw]] emotes, are the only emotes to play global sounds.
*The sound of eating ham is taken from the [[w:c:plantsvszombies:Chomper (PvZ)|Chomper]] from ''Plants vs. Zombies''.
*When using the emote, the player will eat the ham. Smacking sounds can be heard after eating the ham.
*The '''Raw Dinner''' emote (more specifically the ham) could be seen in the [[Trailers#Trailer Nine|Frost Invasion Event Trailer]].
